overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for NLA: the pages have clean, consistent headings and all seven-section content lands in the right place, with arbeidskrav correctly kept out of assessment and nested Kunnskap/Ferdigheter sub-headings kept inside learning_outcomes. The pre-pass flags on the four suspects are false alarms; the only real issues are minor (Praksis cross-references filed as teaching_methods, and Progresjonskrav text dropped).

findings.description: The NLA 'Praksis' heading is mapped to teaching_methods, so a one-line cross-reference to a separate practice plan is appended to the real teaching-methods text. It is not a teaching method; it is a pointer (and for several courses an admin note about which student group it applies to).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps the pattern for 'Praksis' to teaching_methods unconditionally.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Praksis' to .drop (or to unmapped) for NLA, or only keep it when it has more than a 'Se/Sjå ... praksisplan/studieplan' reference (strip lines starting with 'Se ' / 'Sjå ' + 'praksisplan|studieplan' in .clean_sections()).

findings.evidence: Masteroppgaven kan leveres til vurdering når alle obligatoriske og valgte emner fra grunnskolelærerutdanningen 1-7 er bestått.
findings.description: The 'Progresjonskrav' heading is unmapped and its text (progression requirement: what must be passed before the course/thesis can be taken or submitted) is silently discarded. It is a prerequisite-like condition and is not present in any extracted section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No heading-map pattern for 'Progresjonskrav' in R/section_heading_map.R, so the block is unmapped and dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern '^progresjonskrav' mapped to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R.
